provenance.prompt: Purpose: authored company decor for a static ground cabinet with one state-driven hinged door. Specification: overall installation envelope 0.90m wide x 1.20m high x 0.55m deep, body outer depth 0.45m, top board 0.90m x 0.45m x 0.035m with top at 1.20m. Units are metres, up is +Y, forward is +Z, and the bottom-centred origin is the installation base. Installation and load bearing: ground-blocking dynamic facility with one bottom-centred hinged leaf and one top support surface. Keep the door, handle and trim inside its pivot bounds when closed and leave the top clearance prism empty. Budget: deterministic CPU-only primitive geometry and binary GLB export with no external art. State: openFraction only, no animation clip, pickup or automatic clock. Source/export: project-authored Three.js 0.187.0 parameters, GLTFExporter and GLTFLoader readback. Design difference: Project-authored single-door cabinet with a full solid leaf and raised rectangular frame rails over its face. Contract: one door uses pivot [-0.42,0,0.245], local bounds x[0,0.84], y[0.1,1.12], z[-0.02,0.03], and rotates from 0 to -PI/2 around Y.
